# SteamForge test combo — every shape the parser must handle
# comments start with #, //, or ;

# 1. plain
testuser01:PasswordOne123

# 2. email as account name (Steam accepts email login)
someone@example.com:Hunter2!

# 3. password containing a colon (base64-ish)
colonuser:aG9yYQ==:cGFzcw==

# 4. trailing extra fields (cookie / totp / note)
cookieuser:SuperSecret:MOBILE:steamLoginSecure=abc123

# 5. reversed line (pass:user) — parser should flip it
ReversedP@ssw0rd:reverseduser

# 6. SteamID64 as account name
76561198000000000:IdLoginPass1

# 7. duplicate of row 1 (case-insensitive) — should be dropped
TESTUSER01:PasswordOne123

# 8. malformed — no colon, should be skipped
thislinehasnocolon

# 9. malformed — empty password side
emptyuser:

# 10. persona handle with dashes
persona-handle_99:PersonaPass99

# 11. empty password slot then blank lines follow


# 12. normal row after blanks
lastuser:LastPass999
